text:
Ethan: Quick sync, we need a nimble social plan for the Q3 launch: X thread, LinkedIn carousel, and two timed reply touchpoints. Who can own scheduling + monitoring?
Priya: Ill own copy + A/B setup. CTA = webinar RSVP; second touch points to benchmark post. Will prepare product-led and benchmark-led variants.
Zoe: I'll handle design. Deliverables: 3-slide LinkedIn carousel, square hero card, and a lightweight benchmark PNG for thread slide 2. Need copy by Mon 9am PT.
Marco: I can schedule & pin replies. Using Buffer for X and Sprout Social for LinkedIn. Will wire a Zap to push high-intent replies to #sdr-inbound.
LeadsOps: Confirm SFDC mapping: campaign = "Q3_Model_Launch", lead_source = social, queue = sdr-q3-launch. Well tag lead with thread_ts for traceability. High-intent keywords: "pricing", "demo", "POC", "trial".
Ethan: Proposed schedule (UTC):
```
2026-07-14,08:00,linkedin,carousel,carousel-1
2026-07-14,08:05,x,hero,card-1
2026-07-14,08:30,x,thread-start,thread-1
2026-07-15,09:00,x,followup,reply-1
```
Priya: Short X copy A (product hook): "Ship LLM features with predictable latency & lower infra spend. Join our launch webinar -> https://redwood.ai/webinar"
Priya: Short X copy B (benchmark hook): "Benchmarks show 25-40% token cost savings at production scale. Live walkthrough in our webinar -> https://redwood.ai/webinar"
Zoe: Asset specs: carousel slides 1080x1080, hero 1200x675, benchmark PNG 1200x900. Provide alt-text for accessibility.
Marco: Pinned replies templates:
1) "Thanks! We'll cover latency & cost in the webinar. Save your seat: https://redwood.ai/webinar"
2) "Benchmark highlights here: https://redwood.ai/benchmarks  DM us for the CSV."
Marco: I'll pin both replies for 48h and set the Zap to DM the SDR rota on keyword match. Also will export daily reply summaries to #sdr-inbound.
LeadsOps: Use UTM params: utm_source=x|linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=q3_model_launch. Bitly the links and include the short URL in posts.
Ethan: Action items:
- Priya: final copy variants by Mon 9am PT
- Zoe: assets + alt text by Mon 5pm PT
- Marco: schedule + pinned replies + Zap wiring by Tue 9am PT
- LeadsOps: confirm SFDC mapping and SDR rota by Tue 5pm PT
Priya: Posting the two copy variants here in an hour for quick team review.
Zoe: Will attach design brief + initial comps in #assets. Need raw benchmark numbers from eng to build chart.
Ethan: I'll pull numbers and upload to #assets now. Reconvene Tue 10am PT for final go/no-go. :calendar:
